rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical ringing bell.

example.english: This bell rings as soon as you strike it.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zung1 jat1 haau1 zau6 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this for a telephone call, rather than for the ringing instrument.

example.english: I’ll give you a bell in a bit.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this for the sound of a bell as a signal, including a school's start-or-end-of-class bell.

example.english: When the bell rings, everyone goes back to the classroom.
example.traditional: 鐘聲一響，大家就返課室。
example.jyutping: zung1 seng1 jat1 hoeng2 daai6 gaa1 zau6 faan1 fo3 sat1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a bicycle bell mounted on the handlebars.

example.english: The bell on my bike is broken; it won’t ring no matter how much I press it.
example.traditional: 部單車個車鈴壞咗，撳極都唔響。
example.jyutping: bou6 daan1 ce1 go3 ce1 ling4 waai6 zo2 gam6 gik6 dou1 m4 hoeng2
